answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock blocks bulk fakes. A new agent locks 50 POA and builds a fingerprint over 20 epochs: tasks like grading walnut, irregular timing, checked by peers. Clones share patterns, like ships at one wharf berth, so their escrow is slashed. An honest agent pays once, unlocks its bond, and earns undiluted rewards. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 POA for 1,000 fingerprints: sampling nectar hourly exposes clones.
